literature.claim: Single-junction efficiency peaks for absorbers near 1.34 eV (detailed-balance limit ≈33.7%).
Mixed Sn-Pb iodide perovskites show anomalous bandgap bowing: mixed films absorb further into the IR than either end member.
literature.source: Hao et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 136, 8094 (2014)

literature.claim: FA/Cs Sn-Pb (≈50% Sn) films reach ≈1.2-1.25 eV and serve as low-gap tandem subcells.
Sn(II) readily oxidises to Sn(IV), creating p-doping and fast degradation; stability drops with Sn content.
literature.source: Noel et al., Energy Environ. Sci. 7, 3061 (2014)

literature.claim: Mixed I/Br films phase-segregate under illumination (Hoke effect) when Br ≳ 20%.
Adding a small fraction of Cs to FA/MA perovskites improves phase stability and reproducibility.
literature.source: Saliba et al., Energy Environ. Sci. 9, 1989 (2016)

literature.claim: MA-based perovskites are intrinsically thermally unstable at 85 °C.
literature.source: Conings et al., Adv. Energy Mater. 5, 1500477 (2015)

literature.claim: 3D perovskite formability is predicted by the Goldschmidt tolerance factor, roughly 0.8 < t < 1.0.
